# task-franka-sorting (full context)

This file is the single-document context dump. Index: `llms.txt`. Human landing page: `README.md`.

## What it is

An Isaac Lab extension. A Franka arm with a Robotiq 2F-85 gripper sorts randomly placed industrial parts from a
container into the cells of a `parts_tray_*` tray. Each cell takes one part type. The part-to-cell mapping is random per
task and stated in the instruction text. Parts never overlap each other, the container walls or the tray.

Stack: SortingPlanner (scripted stage machine) -> PPO tool-pose tracker (rsl_rl, `best_policy/best_policy.pt`) ->
damped-least-squares IK -> 8-D absolute joint targets. Physics 180 Hz, control 15 Hz, enhanced determinism on.

Planner stages: INIT, APPROACH, CLOSE, CARRY, OPEN, RETRACT, RECOVER, DONE. APPROACH needs the tool point within 6 mm
(xy) and 7 mm (z) of the grasp centre. Tool-point coordinates are in the robot root frame.

## Gym IDs

| ID                                      | Use                                                  |
| --------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| `Nepher-FrankaSorting-HL-Play-v0`       | Planner plus tracker, every task of a bundle         |
| `Nepher-FrankaSorting-HL-EnvhubPlay-v0` | Same, loads `best_policy/best_policy.pt` (evaluator) |
| `Nepher-FrankaSorting-LL-v0`            | Train the tracker                                    |
| `Nepher-FrankaSorting-LL-Play-v0`       | Play the tracker                                     |

## Assets and benchmarks

The package ships only the robot USD. Everything else is in EnvHub bundles in `source/envhub/environments/`.

- `franka-sorting-parts-v2`: 160 tasks in blocks of 16 that share one background, all assets and backgrounds. Append-only: task `i` is a pure function of `i`
  and the library. A change of existing rows needs `--rewrite`.
- `franka-sorting-parts-v0`, `-v1`: 16 tasks each, different seeds, the same tray library, with only the assets
  they reference.
- Containers: `grey_bin`, `purple_crate`, `container_f24`, `bin_b04`, `bin_a06`. Tasks sample oak, maple, bamboo, and black.
- Trays: 1x1, 1x2, 2x2, 2x3. Cells are 150 mm by 200 mm and 6-8 cm deep, eight finishes, 32 trays.
- A task sorts 3-6 part types. The bin holds 20-40 parts. Success is at least 4-6 parts in a correct cell within 30 s.
- Parts are 3x, except nine wide variants (the square-window brackets, the two larger washers, the three large
  plates, and `union_body_v3`) at 2.5x.
- Container colliders are invisible boxes (floor slab and four walls). Deep bins are scaled down to 0.165 m depth
  because `panda_link7` hangs about 0.156 m above the tool point.
- Entities are named `obj0..objN`, container first.

## Layout code (`source/franka_sorting/franka_sorting/layout/`)

`sampler.py` places parts without overlap (`wall_clearance` 0.05 m). `validate.py` re-checks every layout.
`instruction.py` writes the instruction text with the cell mapping. `catalog.py` reads the asset catalog.

## SDG (`scripts/record_lerobot.py`)

The parent process starts no Kit. It runs `record_shard.py` for each shard and retries a shard that stops short.
State: `meta/sdg_state.json`. Report: `sdg_report.json`. Output: LeRobot v2.1, atomic writes, `info.json` last,
`annotation.phase` per frame. Sources: `--source benchmark` (bundle tasks) and `--source procedural` (fresh layouts).
Quality gates: too_short, too_long, nan, joint_limit, joint_jump (0.30 rad per step), gripper_range, blank_frames,
invalid_start, lost_part, not_success.

## Commands

```bash
./isaaclab.sh -p -m pip install -e "source/task-franka-sorting/source/franka_sorting[record]"
./isaaclab.sh -p source/task-franka-sorting/scripts/record_lerobot.py --env_id franka-sorting-parts-v0 --episodes 8 --output datasets/sorting
./isaaclab.sh play --task Nepher-FrankaSorting-HL-EnvhubPlay-v0 --num_envs 16 --viz none env.highlight=on "env.highlight_tasks=0-15"
_isaac_sim\python.bat -m pytest source/task-franka-sorting/tests
```
